The catalog is a declared RAG/few-shot corpus, so an example omitting a required key teaches authors an invalid shape that only renders because a fallback papers over it — same corpus-must-not-lie principle as the shorthand census that ran through the dashboard-filters teaching sweep. Dispatch shape when taken: add the required `value` keys to `basic-accordion.json`'s items (and sweep sibling catalog entries under the same id family for the same omission); whether the renderer's `item.value || item-\${index}` fallback should itself tighten is a separate contract question — record a reading on it in the PR body, do not change it in the same S dispatch.
